questions.subject: mathematics
questions.content:
The median of a set of 9 distinct observations is 20.5. If each of the largest 4 observations of
the set is increased by 2, then the median of the new set :

options.content: is two times the original median
remains the same as that of the original set

questions.explanation:
Here total no of observation is 9 which is a odd number. As we know for odd number 9 the median will be the 5th term.

Now question says, you increase largest 4 number by 2 which does not affect the 5th term so the new median will be the same.
